origin.lens: DefineConstants twin: identical contentHash, different program

description: Byte-identical source to fifthway-ex; the csproj adds ASHLAR_EVIL and the build compiles a File.WriteAllText backdoor into ExecuteAsync. Both twins ADMITTED with the same signed hash until the legs compiled under the build's options. No witness can observe a file write, so the mutants inside the backdoor survive and the reason must name that code. (The oracle wrote under /tmp/fifthway/out; the path is made temp-local here so the verdict does not depend on that directory existing.)
